page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Running head at top centre. Below the text: place, date and year in the closing lines. No margin notes, no notes below the text.

main_text.p: uersanti, iucundum fuisse existimo, tueri aduersus sinistrum fatum: erit & pietatis, meditatione diuinæ Prouidentiæ (cuius quasi Commentarium scholasticum tibi offero) animum præmunire non solùm aduersus casus tristes, quibus hæc nostra vita obnoxia est: sed etiam aduersus illecebras blandientis fortunæ seu rerum secundarum, quæ fere maius, quàm aduersa, periculum creare solent.

Quod superest, Deum Patrem, per sanctum nomen Iesu Christi filij ipsius unigeniti, toto pectore oro, vt ad suam laudem, & Reipub. utilitatem, laudatissimorum̄ Parentum tuorum sanctam & liberalem voluptatem, id quod in te cœpit, perficiat, vt per omnem vitam pie, iuste, temperanter & studiose viuas, sisq; Patria & tibi-ipsi præsidio & ornamento. Amen. Per-scriptum Basileæ Calendis Septemb, Anno Christi 1582.

page.notes: Two ornamented initials: "Q" of "Quod" is a decorative swash letter, transcribed as Q. Text printed in italic throughout; italic marked only where it is set as the body. Doubtful readings: "maius" in "quæ fere maius" is as printed; "Parentum" carries a macron-like mark over the m-stroke, transcribed as printed. The year is printed in a larger italic hand: "1582". "Amen." and the date line are closing matter, kept as paragraph text. The line "Anno Christi" is set in a separate line in the printed page; the date is run into the paragraph here for continuity. Leading page number and signature are not printed on this page.
